latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Free Video Generator No Limits

- Instantly generate and export ready-to-share 30-second videos with no credit limits or paywalls.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB; AI auto-creates videos from your inputs in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple onboarding with automatic setup of API tokens, session, and credits.
- Export 1080p MP4 videos with background music and text overlays.
- Full cloud-based rendering pipeline; all actions routed by user intent for seamless creation and editing.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows for content creators.
